decisionNotes.APPROVED_LABEL: Not used. None of the 5 items have unambiguous visible-label evidence for label-only approval. All 5 are body/procedural slots where approving a label would risk misrepresenting the slot semantics.
decisionNotes.DEFER: Used for all 5 items. Evidence summary: 3 BM-069 slots (W2R-017/018/024) are sentence-trailing body slots without visible Vietnamese labels; 2 BM-073 slots (W2R-025/026) match the closure-report §1 systemic false-header pattern where the slot sits in a body/title line ('Thay đổi' / 'Xét thấy') rather than on the visible 'Số:' / 'ngày tháng năm' header lines.
decisionNotes.LEGAL_REVIEW: Not used. None of the 5 items clearly involve legal/procedural effect that a non-lawyer review must bless. The body slots are about layout/binding, not legal semantics.
decisionNotes.DOCX_REAUTHOR_REQUIRED: Not used. The slot paths (document.fullDocumentCode, document.issueDate, document.reasonLine, document.summaryLine) are plausible at the contract level — the issue is that the slot lands in the wrong paragraph in the rendered DOCX (false-body position). This is a path/binding investigation issue, not a missing-field issue like W2R-027/028 (BM-073 person.dateOfBirth/CCCD). Marking DEFER for now; future DOCX_REAUTHOR lane can reclassify if path/binding investigation confirms the slots need to be moved, not removed.
